name: lightroom-mcp
description: Bridge Claude to Adobe Lightroom Classic — search, organize, develop, export.
long_description: Connects Claude to a running Adobe Lightroom Classic instance via a bundled Lua plugin. Tools cover catalog search, collections, ratings, keywords, develop presets and settings, import and export. The Lightroom plugin is auto-installed into Lightroom's Modules folder on first run; restart Lightroom once after install to load it.

tools.name: search_photos
tools.description: Search the catalog by metadata, EXIF, location, flag, label, edit state, or date.

tools.name: get_catalog_info
tools.description: Active catalog path, Lightroom version, and photo/collection counts.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: Folders in the catalog with their on-disk paths and hierarchy.

tools.name: list_keywords
tools.description: The catalog's keyword hierarchy, with synonyms and export flags.

tools.name: get_photo_preview
tools.description: Render a JPEG preview of a photo to inspect how it actually looks.

tools.name: get_selected_photos
tools.description: Photos currently selected in Lightroom (or the filmstrip).

tools.name: set_selected_photos
tools.description: Select photos in the Lightroom UI so the user can see a result set.

tools.name: get_photo_metadata
tools.description: Detailed EXIF + develop metadata for a photo.

tools.name: set_photo_metadata
tools.description: Write IPTC/XMP fields: title, caption, creator, copyright, location, GPS.

tools.name: set_flag
tools.description: Set the pick / unflag / reject flag on photos.

tools.name: set_color_label
tools.description: Set or clear the color label on photos.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: All collections, with full set paths and photo counts.

tools.name: list_collection_sets
tools.description: Collection sets, for use as a parent when creating collections.

tools.name: get_collection_photos
tools.description: List the photos inside one collection.

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create a collection, optionally inside a collection set.

tools.name: create_collection_set
tools.description: Create a collection set to group collections.

tools.name: create_smart_collection
tools.description: Create a self-updating smart collection from search criteria.

tools.name: add_to_collection
tools.description: Add photos to a collection.

tools.name: remove_from_collection
tools.description: Remove photos from a collection (photos stay in the catalog).

tools.name: rename_collection
tools.description: Rename an existing collection.

tools.name: delete_collection
tools.description: Delete a collection (photos stay in the catalog).

tools.name: set_keywords
tools.description: Add or remove keywords on photos.

tools.name: set_rating
tools.description: Set the star rating on photos.

tools.name: import_photos
tools.description: Import photos from a path into the catalog.

tools.name: export_photos
tools.description: Export photos to a destination folder.

tools.name: list_develop_presets
tools.description: Lightroom-visible presets and plugin-managed checkpoints.

tools.name: get_develop_preset
tools.description: Settings and backing-file metadata for one preset.

tools.name: compare_develop_presets
tools.description: Deterministic per-setting diff between two presets.

tools.name: create_develop_preset
tools.description: Capture a versioned preset checkpoint from a photo.

tools.name: export_develop_preset
tools.description: Copy a preset's backing file to a destination directory.

tools.name: apply_develop_preset
tools.description: Apply a Develop preset to photos.

tools.name: copy_develop_settings
tools.description: Copy Develop settings from one photo to others.

tools.name: set_develop_settings
tools.description: Set Develop settings directly on a photo.

request_port.title: Plugin request port
request_port.description: TCP port the Lightroom plugin listens on for requests. Must match the Plug-in Manager setting.

response_port.title: Plugin response port
response_port.description: TCP port the Lightroom plugin sends responses on. Must match the Plug-in Manager setting.
